criteria.description: Material level matches the available source and never upgrades metadata or an abstract to located full text.
Located full text has a reproducible page, block, range, anchor, and exact excerpt; lower levels have no false locator.
Stored excerpt and export behavior follow the recorded rights boundary.
Support, refutation, qualification, or context-only relation is faithful to the cited material.

items.description: Research question and scope are explicit.
Sources, query, date, and inclusion or exclusion rules are visible.
Deduplication and version relationships are represented correctly.
Metadata, abstract, full text, and located evidence use correct wording.
Conflicts, counterexamples, and heterogeneity remain visible.
The research gap follows from the evidence matrix.
Bibliographic and publication statuses are represented faithfully.
Unavailable full text and other limitations are explicit.
The next action stays inside the current evidence boundary.
